functions.name: core_rng_init
functions.brief: Initialize the hardware RNG. Enables the peripheral clock, configures the RNG, and waits for the first random number to be ready. On Core.U: requires HSI48 to be running (auto-enabled if USB is used, otherwise call ll_rcc_hsi48_enable() first).

functions.name: core_rng_read
functions.brief: Read a single 32-bit random value (blocking). Returns 0 on timeout — check core_rng_error() if this happens.

functions.name: core_rng_fill
functions.brief: Fill a buffer with random 32-bit values (blocking).

params.name: count
params.description: Number of uint32_t values to generate

functions.name: core_rng_error
functions.brief: Check if the RNG has a seed error (entropy source failure).
